messages.text: Hello! I am your AI architect. Describe the software system you would like to design today. We can brainstorm, and when you are ready, click "Draw Board" below!

Design a simple and scalable system to track 3000 buses in real-time.  Requirements: - Each bus sends GPS location updates every 5–10 seconds - System should handle at least 3000 concurrent buses - Users can view live bus locations on a map - Provide ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) for each bus - System should be fault-tolerant and handle spikes in traffic  Expectations: - High-level architecture diagram (components like frontend, backend, database, message queues, etc.) - Technology stack suggestions (e.g., WebSocket, Kafka, Redis, etc.) - Data flow explanation (how location moves from bus → server → user) - Database design (schema for buses, routes, locations) - Scaling strategy (horizontal scaling, load balancing) - Caching strategy for fast location updates - Real-time communication approach (polling vs WebSockets)  Constraints: - Keep the design simple but production-ready - Optimize for low latency and high availability
